using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Data;
using System.Data.SqlClient;
using System.Drawing;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows.Forms;

namespace Petkunas__Lukas___Doherty_Cars
{
    public partial class frmCustomerData : Form
    {
        #region Private fields
        // currently selected customer ID (-1 indicates none selected)
        private int _selectedCustomer = -1;
        // currently selected field to search by (default is "Firstname")
        private string _selectedField = "Firstname";
        // list of fields to be displayed within the search field ComboBox
        private List<ComboBoxItem> _fields = new List<ComboBoxItem>
        {
            new ComboBoxItem("Customer ID", "CustomerID"),
            new ComboBoxItem("First name", "Firstname"),
            new ComboBoxItem("Surname", "Surname"),
            new ComboBoxItem("Email", "Email"),
            new ComboBoxItem("Phone number", "PhoneNumber")
        };
        #endregion
        public frmCustomerData()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
        }

        #region Create
        // add a new customer with the provided details
        private void btnAdd_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            // ensure that the currently selected user has at least "Restricted Write" permission 
            string PermissionError = Role.CheckAuthorised(CurrentUser.CurrentLoggedInUser.GetAuthorisationLevel(), 1);
            if (PermissionError != null)
            {
                MessageBox.Show(PermissionError, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }

            // ensure that the customer details adhere to the validation set out by the customer class
            List<string> ValidationErrors = Customer.ValidateCustomer(
                0,
                txtFirstname.Text,
                txtSurname.Text,
                txtEmail.Text,
                txtPhoneNumber.Text);

            // if there are any errors, output them and cancel
            if (ValidationErrors.Any())
            {
                MessageBox.Show("- " + string.Join("\n- ", ValidationErrors), "Errors when attempting to save the customer", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }

            try
            {
                // attempt to create a new customer object with the provided details
                Customer NewCustomer = new Customer(0, txtFirstname.Text, txtSurname.Text, txtEmail.Text, txtPhoneNumber.Text);

                // if that works, attempt to add the customer to the database
                string AddingMessage = Customer.AddCustomer(NewCustomer);

                // no error message has been output
                if (AddingMessage == null)
                {
                    MessageBox.Show("Customer has been added successfully.", "Success", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);

                    // ensure adding is only logged when successful - prevents logs regarding non-existent records
                    Logging.WriteLog(Logging.LogType.Create, $"customer ({txtFirstname.Text} {txtSurname.Text})");
                }
                else
                {
                    string MessageboxText = "Customer has not been added:\n" + AddingMessage;
                    MessageBox.Show(MessageboxText, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Adding was unsuccessful with the following error message: " + ex.Message, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }
            LoadFormDefaults();  // reset form fields and refresh the data grid view
        }
        #endregion
        #region Retrieve
        private void AttemptDataDisplay()
        {
            // populate the data grid view with the latest version of the customers database stored when the form is loaded
            List<Customer> Result = Customer.RetrieveCustomers();


            // if no customers could be loaded due to a system error (i.e., null was returned instead of an empty list)
            if (Result == null)
            {
                // prevent further modification
                MessageBox.Show("There was an error when attempting to load customer data. Please amend erroneous data in the database before proceeding.");
                LockDownForm();
                return;
            }
            else
            {
                // display the data
                dgvCustomers.DataSource = Result;
            }


            // modify column headers to be more human readable
            dgvCustomers.Columns["CustomerID"].HeaderText = "Customer ID";
            dgvCustomers.Columns["FirstName"].HeaderText = "First Name";
            dgvCustomers.Columns["Surname"].HeaderText = "Last Name";
            dgvCustomers.Columns["Email"].HeaderText = "Email Address";
            dgvCustomers.Columns["PhoneNumber"].HeaderText = "Phone Number";

            // resize the columns to match the data length
            dgvCustomers.AutoResizeColumns();
        }

        // when loading the form, load data from the database and add search fields to the search field combobox
        private void frmCustomerData_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            AttemptDataDisplay();
            foreach (ComboBoxItem field in _fields) comboSearchField.Items.Add(field);

            comboSearchField.SelectedIndex = 0;
            comboSearchType.SelectedIndex = 0;
        }

        // when a new customer is selected
        private void dgvCustomers_SelectionChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            // if there are customers
            if (dgvCustomers.RowCount > 0)
            {
                try
                {
                    // retrieve the selected user using their id (the first column)
                    Customer Edit = Customer.RetrieveByCustomerID(Convert.ToInt32(dgvCustomers.CurrentRow.Cells[0].Value));

                    // if there is a customer with that id, load their data
                    if (Edit != null)
                    {
                        _selectedCustomer = Edit.CustomerID;
                        txtCustomerID.Text = Edit.CustomerID.ToString();
                        txtFirstname.Text = Edit.FirstName;
                        txtSurname.Text = Edit.Surname;
                        txtEmail.Text = Edit.Email;
                        txtPhoneNumber.Text = Edit.PhoneNumber;
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    MessageBox.Show("Error when attempting to select user:\n" + ex);
                }
            }
        }
        #endregion
        #region Update
        // save the selected customer with the new input details
        private void btnSaveCustomer_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            // ensure that the currently selected user has at least "Restricted Write" permission 
            string PermissionError = Role.CheckAuthorised(CurrentUser.CurrentLoggedInUser.GetAuthorisationLevel(), 1);

            // if not, display permission needed and permission currently possessed and cancel
            if (PermissionError != null)
            {
                MessageBox.Show(PermissionError);
                return;
            }

            // ensure that a customer has been selected to edit before attempting to push changes
            if (_selectedCustomer == -1)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Choose a customer to edit");
                return;
            }

            // ensure that the customer details adhere to the validation set out by the customer class
            List<string> ValidationErrors = Customer.ValidateCustomer(
                Convert.ToInt32(txtCustomerID.Text),
                txtFirstname.Text,
                txtSurname.Text,
                txtEmail.Text,
                txtPhoneNumber.Text
                );

            // if there are any errors, output them and cancel
            if (ValidationErrors.Any())
            {   // "- " + error1 + new line + "- " + error2 + new line +...
                MessageBox.Show("- " + string.Join("\n- ", ValidationErrors), "Errors", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }

            // ensure that the user wishes to follow through
            DialogResult NewDialog = MessageBox.Show("Are you sure that you want to overwrite changes?", "Save changes", MessageBoxButtons.YesNo);
            if (NewDialog == DialogResult.Yes)
            {
                try
                {
                    // as well as the validation previous carried out, a customer object is created to ensure that a valid representation can be created on the system with the provided details
                    string ErrorMessage = Customer.SaveCustomer(new Customer(Convert.ToInt32(txtCustomerID.Text), txtFirstname.Text, txtSurname.Text, txtEmail.Text, txtPhoneNumber.Text));

                    if (ErrorMessage != null)
                        MessageBox.Show(ErrorMessage, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                    else
                        MessageBox.Show("Successfully updated customer");

                    // log the update, whether successful or not, with the old and new details stored
                    Logging.WriteLog(Logging.LogType.Update, "customer " + $"{txtCustomerID.Text} ({txtFirstname.Text} {txtSurname.Text})");

                    // refresh the data in the table with the updated record
                    LoadFormDefaults();
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    MessageBox.Show("Save was unsuccessful with the following error message:\n" + ex.Message, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                }
            }
        }
        #endregion
        #region Delete
        private void btnDelete_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            // ensure that the currently selected user has at least "Unrestricted Write" permission 
            string PermissionError = Role.CheckAuthorised(CurrentUser.CurrentLoggedInUser.GetAuthorisationLevel(), 2);
            if (PermissionError != null)
            {
                MessageBox.Show(PermissionError);
                return;
            }

            // ensure that a customer has been selected to be deleted
            if (_selectedCustomer == -1)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Select a customer to delete.");
                return;
            }

            DialogResult NewDialog = MessageBox.Show("Are you sure you wish to delete the selected record? This action will cascade through other tables.", "Warning!", MessageBoxButtons.YesNo);
            if (NewDialog == DialogResult.Yes)
            {
                string ErrorMessage = Customer.DeleteCustomer(Convert.ToInt32(txtCustomerID.Text));
                // if unsuccessful
                if (ErrorMessage != null) MessageBox.Show(ErrorMessage, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                else Logging.WriteLog(Logging.LogType.Delete, $"customer {txtCustomerID.Text} ({txtFirstname.Text} {txtSurname.Text})"); // if successful
                LoadFormDefaults();
            }
        }
        #endregion
        #region Search
        // update the field to search
        private void comboSearchField_SelectedValueChanged(object sender, EventArgs e) => _selectedField = ((ComboBoxItem)comboSearchField.SelectedItem).HiddenValue;

        // update the table to have search the database against the latest search substring provided
        private void txtSearch_TextChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            // modify the name of the type of query to be made, then update the form with that query
            string SearchType = (comboSearchType.SelectedItem?.ToString() == "Exact") ? "Exact" : "Contains";
            dgvCustomers.DataSource = Customer.RetrieveCustomersByField(txtSearch.Text, SearchType, _selectedField);
        }
        #endregion
        #region Misc
        private void LoadFormDefaults()
        {
            // resets form fields and refreshes the data grid view
            AttemptDataDisplay();
            txtFirstname.Clear();
            txtSurname.Clear();
            txtEmail.Clear();
            txtPhoneNumber.Clear();
            _selectedCustomer = -1;
        }

        // prevents further modification of data by disabling all controls which allow for it
        private void LockDownForm()
        {
            btnAdd.Enabled = false;
            btnSave.Enabled = false;
            btnDelete.Enabled = false;
            btnReset.Enabled = false;

            txtFirstname.Enabled = false;
            txtSurname.Enabled = false;
            txtEmail.Enabled = false;
            txtPhoneNumber.Enabled = false;

            txtCustomerID.Enabled = false;

            txtSearch.Enabled = false;
            comboSearchField.Enabled = false;
            comboSearchType.Enabled = false;

            dgvCustomers.Enabled = false;
        }

        private void btnReset_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            // reset the fields by setting everything to its default state
            LoadFormDefaults();
        }

        private void btnHelp_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            // display the help form
            frmHelpCustomers frm = new frmHelpCustomers();
            frm.Show();
        }
        #endregion







    }
}

========================================
FILE: frmLogin.cs
========================================

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Data;
using System.Drawing;
using System.Linq;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows.Forms;

namespace Petkunas__Lukas___Doherty_Cars
{
    public partial class frmLogin : Form
    {
        public frmLogin()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
        }

        #region Login logic
        private void btnLogin_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            // username is converted to lowercase for simplicity, but password is not for case sensitivty - ensure security
            string Username = txtUsername.Text.ToLower().Trim();
            string Password = txtPassword.Text.Trim();

            if (!LoginValidation(Username, Password))
                return; // stop if basic validation fails.

            // attempt to authenticate user
            Staff NewStaff = Staff.Login(Username, Password);

            // if the login method executed successfully and a user was returned, store that user's details in memory, log the login and continue to the main menu
            if (NewStaff != null)
            {
                CurrentUser.CurrentLoggedInUser = NewStaff;
                Logging.WriteLog(Logging.LogType.Login, null);
                frmMainMenu newMainMenu = new frmMainMenu();
                newMainMenu.Show();
                this.Hide();
            }
            else // else output an error message, log a failed attempt and clear fields
            {
                // check if no staff members were found because of a server error or just because of incorrect credentials
                if (Staff.RetrieveStaffMembers() != null)
                    MessageBox.Show("Incorrect username or password, please try again.", "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);

                // log unsuccessful login attempt using the username, removing "[" and "]" which are used in the logs file to delineate the time and log type sections
                Logging.WriteLog(Logging.LogType.LoginAttempt, txtUsername.Text.Replace("[", "").Replace("]", ""));
                txtUsername.Text = "";
                txtPassword.Text = "";
                txtUsername.Focus();

            }
        }

        // when the form is loaded, ensuring that any previous details in memory have been cleared to prevent session clashes
        private void frmLogin_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            this.KeyPreview = true;
            CurrentUser.CurrentLoggedInUser = null;
        }

        // ensure the user inputs valid data in the fields
        public bool LoginValidation(string username, string password)
        {
            // if both fields are blank
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(username) && string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(password))
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Sorry, you cannot leave username and password blank", "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return false;
            }


            // if only one field is blank
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(username))
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Sorry, you cannot leave username blank", "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return false;
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(password))
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Sorry, you cannot leave password blank", "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return false;
            }

            // if the username is not alphanumeric or with underscores
            if (!Regex.IsMatch(username, @"^[a-z0-9_.]+$"))
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Username can only contain letters, numbers, underscores and full stops.", "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return false;
            }

            // if the username is too short/long
            if (username.Length < 3 || username.Length > 50)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Username must be between 3 and 50 characters.", "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return false;
            }

            // if the password is too short/long
            if (password.Length < 8 || password.Length > 128)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Password must be between 8 and 128 characters.", "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return false;
            }

            return true;
        }

        // listen for the enter key to ensure that pressing enter will trigger a login attempt regardless of selected field
        private void frmLogin_KeyPress(object sender, KeyPressEventArgs e)
        {
            if (e.KeyChar == (char)Keys.Enter) btnLogin_Click(sender, e);
        }
        #endregion
        #region Misc logic
        private void chkToggleHide_CheckedChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            if (chkToggleHide.Checked == true)
            {
                // make the password visible if checked
                txtPassword.PasswordChar = '\0';
                txtPassword.ForeColor = Color.Black;
            }
            else
            {
                // obfuscate the password if unchecked
                txtPassword.PasswordChar = '*';
                txtPassword.ForeColor = Color.DarkGray;
            }
        }

        // populate fields with existing user information for testing
        private void btnUser1_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            txtUsername.Text = "patdoh";
            txtPassword.Text = "Password1.";
        }

        private void btnUser2_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            txtUsername.Text = "ethanh1";
            txtPassword.Text = "ethanh1.";
        }

        private void btnUser3_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            txtUsername.Text = "ellar";
            txtPassword.Text = "financial";
        }
        #endregion

    }
}

FILE: frmLogs.cs

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Data;
using System.Drawing;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows.Forms;

namespace Petkunas__Lukas___Doherty_Cars
{
    public partial class frmLogs : Form
    {
        public frmLogs()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
        }


        private void frmLogs_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            // retrieve all logs for the current day
            List<ListViewItem> Logs = Logging.RetrieveLogsAsListViewItems(DateTime.Now, null, null);

            // display them
            foreach (ListViewItem log in Logs)
            {
                lvLogs.Items.Add(log); 
            }

            comboLogType.SelectedIndex = 0;
            comboStaffMember.SelectedIndex = 0;

            // retrieve all staff members from the database
            List<Staff> AllStaffMembers = Staff.RetrieveStaffMembers();

            // if none could be loaded due to a system error, prevent further processing
            if (AllStaffMembers == null)
            {             
                MessageBox.Show("No staff members could be loaded");
                return;
            }

            // add each staff member as a filtering option
            foreach (Staff staff in AllStaffMembers)
            {
                comboStaffMember.Items.Add(new ComboBoxItem($"{staff.StaffID} - {staff.Firstname} {staff.Surname}", Convert.ToString(staff.Username)));
            }

            
        }

        // display new logs when the date is changed
        private void dtpLogDate_ValueChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            UpdateLogs();
        }

        // get the log type selected for filtering from the respective combobox
        private Logging.LogType? GetLogType()
        {
            try
            {
                switch (comboLogType.SelectedItem)
                {
                    case "None": return null;
                    case "LoginAttempt": return Logging.LogType.LoginAttempt;
                    case "Login": return Logging.LogType.Login;
                    case "Access": return Logging.LogType.Access;
                    case "Create": return Logging.LogType.Create;
                    case "Update": return Logging.LogType.Update;
                    case "Delete": return Logging.LogType.Delete;
                    default: return null;
                }
            }
            catch
            {
                return null;
            }
        }

        // get the username of the staff member selected for filtering
        private string GetUsername()
        {
            if (comboStaffMember.SelectedIndex < 0 || comboStaffMember.Text == "None") return null;
            else return ((ComboBoxItem)comboStaffMember.SelectedItem).HiddenValue;

        }

        // display the logs for that current day, filtered by action and user
        private void UpdateLogs()
        {
            List<ListViewItem> logs = Logging.RetrieveLogsAsListViewItems(dtpLogDate.Value, GetLogType(), GetUsername());

            // clear all logs currently displayed
            lvLogs.Items.Clear();

            // display the new fetched logs
            foreach (ListViewItem log in logs)
            {
                lvLogs.Items.Add(log);
            }
        }

        // if the filtering action has been modified
        private void comboLogType_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            UpdateLogs();
        }

        // if the filtering staff member has been modified
        private void comboStaffMember_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            UpdateLogs();
        }

        private void btnHelp_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            frmHelpLogs frm = new frmHelpLogs();
            frm.Show();

        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Data;
using System.Drawing;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows.Forms;

namespace Petkunas__Lukas___Doherty_Cars
{
    public partial class frmMainMenu : Form
    {
        #region Form fields
        // a dictionary that associates the name of the form with the constructor
        // used when changing between forms to prevent separate methods for each form
        readonly Dictionary<string, Func<Form>> formConstructors = new Dictionary<string, Func<Form>> {
            {"StaffData", () => new frmStaffData()},
            {"CustomerData", () => new frmCustomerData()},
            {"VehicleData", () => new frmVehicleData()},
            {"ServiceData", () => new frmServiceData()},
            {"ServiceAppointments", () => new frmServiceAppointments()},
            {"Reports", () => new frmReports()},
            {"Roles", () => new frmRoleData()},
            {"VehicleTypes", () => new frmVehicleTypeData() },
            {"Parts", () => new frmPartData() },
            {"Main", () => new frmStartingMainMenuForm() },
            {"Logs", () => new frmLogs() },
            {"InProgress", () => new frmInProgress() }
        };

        // dictionary that associates each role to a list of buttons they are permitted to use
        Dictionary<string, List<Button>> AuthorisedButtons;

        // all buttons in the form
        List<Button> FormButtons;
        #endregion
        #region Sidebar fields
        // this is global so that each event mouse event can effectively cancel the other by setting it to cancelling value before restarting the count
        int SineTimeElapsed = 0;

        // normal width and hover width of the panel and buttons 
        const int PanelExpandedWidth = 200;
        const int PanelCollapsedWidth = 82;
        const int ButtonExpandedWidth = 190;
        const int ButtonCollapsedWidth = 65;

        // time taken for the animation
        const int TransitionTimeMilliseconds = 100;

        // flag that determines whether the panel has already been entered
        // ensures no bugs occur when moving onto a button, which the program considers separate from the panel
        bool Entered = false;
        #endregion

        public frmMainMenu()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
        }

        #region Form logic
        // remove the form currently displayed in the viewing panel
        private void ResetFormPanel()
        {
            pnlFormDisplay.Controls.Clear();
        }

        // display the appropriate form based on the name of the form provided to the method
        private void ChangeForm(string formName)
        {
            // regex makes the form name more presentable as you can separate it at capitals
            Logging.WriteLog(Logging.LogType.Access, Regex.Replace(formName, "([a-z])([A-Z])", "$1 $2"));
            ResetFormPanel();

            // validation to ensure the selected form exists
            if (!formConstructors.ContainsKey(formName))
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Form not found.", "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }

            // display the selected form
            Form objForm = formConstructors[formName]();
            objForm.TopLevel = false;
            pnlFormDisplay.Controls.Add(objForm);
            objForm.FormBorderStyle = FormBorderStyle.None;
            objForm.Dock = DockStyle.Fill;
            objForm.Show();
        }

        private void btnStaffData_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            ChangeForm("StaffData");
        }

        private void btnCustomerData_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            ChangeForm("CustomerData");
        }

        private void btnLogOut_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            frmLogin newForm = new frmLogin();
            newForm.Show();
            this.Hide();
        }

        private void btnVehicleData_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            ChangeForm("VehicleData");
        }

        private void btnServiceData_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            ChangeForm("ServiceData");
        }

        {
            ChangeForm("ServiceAppointments");
        }

        private void frmMainMenu_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            // ensure that the main menu cannot be opened without logging in first
            if (CurrentUser.CurrentLoggedInUser == null)
            {

                MessageBox.Show("Session expired. Please log in again.", "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                frmLogin login = new frmLogin();
                login.Show();
                this.Close();
                return;
            }

            // attach the hover events to the buttons to ensure that hovering over a button does not cause the panel to collapse
            FormButtons = pnlButtons.Controls.OfType<Button>().ToList();
            foreach (Button button in FormButtons)
            {
                button.MouseEnter += pnlButtons_MouseEnter;
                button.MouseLeave += pnlButtons_MouseLeave;
            }

            ChangeForm("Main");

            // create a new dictionary for role -> permitted buttons, which cannot be initialised outside of the load event
            // as buttons are not initialised when the form is first instantiated
            AuthorisedButtons = new Dictionary<string, List<Button>>
                {
                 {"None", new List<Button>()},
                 {"Administrative",  new List<Button>(){ btnStaffData, btnCustomerData, btnVehicleData, btnServiceAppointments, btnServiceData, btnReports, btnRoleData, btnVehicleTypeData, btnPartData, btnMainMenu, btnLogs, btnEnquiries, btnTestDriveAppointments, btnPointOfSale} },
                 {"Customer Service", new List<Button>(){btnCustomerData, btnReports, btnEnquiries}},
                 {"Technical", new List<Button>(){btnServiceAppointments, btnServiceData, btnVehicleData, btnPartData, btnVehicleTypeData, btnTestDriveAppointments, btnPointOfSale} },
                 {"Finance", new List<Button>(){btnReports, btnPointOfSale}},
                 {"HR", new List<Button>(){ btnLogs, btnEnquiries } }
                };

            var role = Role.RetrieveByRoleID(CurrentUser.CurrentLoggedInUser.RoleID); // get the role of the currently logged-in staff member
            if (role == null || !AuthorisedButtons.ContainsKey(role.Sector)) // if no role was found or the role isn't represented in the dictionary
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Role configuration error.", "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }

            // enable and visually indicate each permitted button
            foreach (Button button in AuthorisedButtons[role.Sector])
            {
                button.Enabled = true;
                button.BackColor = Color.FromArgb(240, 255, 240);
            }


        }

        #endregion
        #region Sidebar logic
        // when the panel is entered, trigger the animation counter for expanding
        private void pnlButtons_MouseEnter(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            SineTimeElapsed = 0;
            Entered = true;
            tmrTransition.Enabled = true;

        }

        // ditto for collapsing
        private void pnlButtons_MouseLeave(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            SineTimeElapsed = 0;
            Entered = false;
            tmrTransition.Enabled = true;

        }

       


        private void toggleButtonTexts(bool textEnabled)
        {
            if (textEnabled)
            {
                foreach (Button button in FormButtons)
                    button.ImageAlign = ContentAlignment.MiddleLeft;

                // manually set each button's text, aligning the image to ensure that the text is readable

                btnStaffData.Text = "Staff";
                btnCustomerData.Text = "Customers";
                btnVehicleData.Text = "Vehicles";
                btnServiceData.Text = "Services";
                btnServiceAppointments.Text = "Service Appointments";
                btnLogs.Text = "Logs";
                btnVehicleTypeData.Text = "Vehicle Types";
                btnEnquiries.Text = "Enquiries";
                btnTestDriveAppointments.Text = "Test Drive Appointments";
                btnReports.Text = "Reports";
                btnPartData.Text = "Parts";
                btnRoleData.Text = "Roles";
            }
            else
            {
                foreach (Button button in FormButtons)
                    button.ImageAlign = ContentAlignment.MiddleCenter;

                // clear each button's text

                btnStaffData.Text = "";            
                btnCustomerData.Text = "";
                btnVehicleData.Text = "";
                btnServiceData.Text = "";
                btnServiceAppointments.Text = "";
                btnLogs.Text = "";
                btnVehicleTypeData.Text = "";
                btnEnquiries.Text = "";
                btnReports.Text = "";
                btnTestDriveAppointments.Text = "";
                btnPartData.Text = "";
                btnRoleData.Text = "";
            }
        }
        private void tmrTransition_Tick(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            // increment the timer
            SineTimeElapsed++;

            if (SineTimeElapsed <= TransitionTimeMilliseconds)
            {
                // recall that sin(pi/2) == 1. therefore, when the loop reaches the desired value, the final size will be reached.

                // retrieve the width of the buttons and panels when starting collapsing/expanding
                int InitialButtonWidth = pnlButtons.Controls.OfType<Button>().ToList()[0].Width;
                int InitialPanelWidth = pnlButtons.Width;

                // indicates how far into the collapse/expand the panel is
                double SineSizeMultiplier = Math.Sin((Math.PI / (2 * TransitionTimeMilliseconds)) * SineTimeElapsed);
                

                // modify the size of the button/panel with the next segment that is to be added/removed
                foreach (Button button in FormButtons)
                {
                    button.Width =
                        Entered ?
                        InitialButtonWidth + Convert.ToInt32((ButtonExpandedWidth - InitialButtonWidth) * SineSizeMultiplier) :
                        InitialButtonWidth - Convert.ToInt32((InitialButtonWidth - ButtonCollapsedWidth) * SineSizeMultiplier);
                }
                pnlButtons.Width = Entered ?
                        InitialPanelWidth + Convert.ToInt32((PanelExpandedWidth - InitialPanelWidth) * SineSizeMultiplier) :
                        InitialPanelWidth - Convert.ToInt32((InitialPanelWidth - PanelCollapsedWidth) * SineSizeMultiplier);
            }
            else if (SineTimeElapsed > TransitionTimeMilliseconds)
            {
                // animation has stopped
                tmrTransition.Enabled = false;
                SineTimeElapsed = 0;
            }

            if (pnlButtons.Width >= PanelExpandedWidth - 10)
            {
                // once the panel is near the end of expanding, show texts
                toggleButtonTexts(true);
            }
            else
            {
                // hide when panel shrinks below that point
                toggleButtonTexts(false);
            }
        }

        #endregion
    }
}

========================================
FILE: frmPartData.cs

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Data;
using System.Linq;
using System.Windows.Forms;

namespace Petkunas__Lukas___Doherty_Cars
{
    public partial class frmPartData : Form
    {
        #region Form properties
        // the id of the part which is to be modified
        private int _selectedPart = -1;

        // the name of the field which is to be searched against
        private string _selectedField = "Name";

        // list of fields which can be searched
        private List<ComboBoxItem> fields = new List<ComboBoxItem>
        {
            new ComboBoxItem("Part ID", "PartID"),
            new ComboBoxItem("Part Name", "Name"),
            new ComboBoxItem("Buy Price", "BuyPrice"),
            new ComboBoxItem("Sell Price", "SellPrice"),
            new ComboBoxItem("Quantity", "Quantity")
        };
        #endregion
        public frmPartData()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
        }
        #region Create
        private void btnAdd_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            // check that current user has at least "Restricted Write" permission before attempting to add a new part
            string PermissionError = Role.CheckAuthorised(CurrentUser.CurrentLoggedInUser.GetAuthorisationLevel(), 1);
            if (PermissionError != null) { MessageBox.Show(PermissionError, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error); return; }

            // ensure that the part passes the validation set out by the class
            List<string> ValidationErrors = Part.ValidatePart(0, txtName.Text, numBuyPrice.Value, numSellPrice.Value, (int)numQuantity.Value);
            if (ValidationErrors.Any())
            {
                MessageBox.Show("- " + string.Join("\n- ", ValidationErrors), "Errors adding part", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }

            try
            {
                // attempt to create a part object using the data
                Part NewPart = new Part(0, txtName.Text, numBuyPrice.Value, numSellPrice.Value, (int)numQuantity.Value);
                // attempt to add that new part
                string Message = Part.AddPart(NewPart);
                if (Message == null)
                {
                    MessageBox.Show("Part added successfully.", "Success", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);
                    Logging.WriteLog(Logging.LogType.Create, $"part ({txtName.Text})");
                }
                else MessageBox.Show("Part not added:\n" + Message, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("There was an error adding the new part:\n" + ex.Message, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
            }
            LoadFormDefaults();
        }
        #endregion
        #region Retrieve
        // display data, and populate the field combobox with the available fields
        private void frmPartData_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            AttemptDataDisplay();
            foreach (ComboBoxItem field in fields) comboSearchField.Items.Add(field);

            comboSearchField.SelectedIndex = 0;
            comboSearchType.SelectedIndex = 0;
        }


        private void AttemptDataDisplay()
        {

            List<Part> Result = Part.RetrieveParts();

            // if no parts could be retrieved due to a server error
            if (Result == null)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Error loading parts. Please contact the administrator.");
                LockDownForm();
                return;
            }

            dgvParts.DataSource = Result;
            // make column headers human-readable
            dgvParts.Columns["PartID"].HeaderText = "Part ID";
            dgvParts.Columns["Name"].HeaderText = "Part Name";
            dgvParts.Columns["BuyPrice"].HeaderText = "Buy Price";
            dgvParts.Columns["SellPrice"].HeaderText = "Sell Price";
            dgvParts.Columns["Quantity"].HeaderText = "Quantity";

            dgvParts.AutoResizeColumns();
        }

        // if a part has been selected within the datagridview
        private void dgvParts_SelectionChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            // if there are no parts, do not attempt to display
            if (dgvParts.RowCount <= 0) return;

            try
            {
                // retrieve the appropriate part using the selected row's id
                Part Edit = Part.RetrieveByPartID(Convert.ToInt32(dgvParts.CurrentRow.Cells["PartID"].Value));

                // if the part has not been deleted
                if (Edit != null)
                {
                    _selectedPart = Edit.PartID;
                    txtPartID.Text = Edit.PartID.ToString();
                    txtName.Text = Edit.Name;
                    numBuyPrice.Value = Edit.BuyPrice;
                    numSellPrice.Value = Edit.SellPrice;
                    numQuantity.Value = Edit.Quantity;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Error selecting part: " + ex.Message, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
            }
        }

        #endregion
        #region Update
        private void btnSave_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            // check that current user has at least "Restricted Write" permission before attempting to save changes to a part
            string PermissionError = Role.CheckAuthorised(CurrentUser.CurrentLoggedInUser.GetAuthorisationLevel(), 1);
            if (PermissionError != null) { MessageBox.Show(PermissionError, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error); return; }

            // if no part has been selected
            if (_selectedPart == -1) { MessageBox.Show("Select a part to edit.", "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error); return; }

            // ensure that the part passes the validation set out by the class
            List<string> ValidationErrors = Part.ValidatePart(int.Parse(txtPartID.Text), txtName.Text, numBuyPrice.Value, numSellPrice.Value, (int)numQuantity.Value);
            if (ValidationErrors.Any())
            {
                MessageBox.Show("- " + string.Join("\n- ", ValidationErrors), "Errors saving part", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }

            // verify that the user wants to update the part
            DialogResult Confirm = MessageBox.Show("Are you sure that you want to overwrite changes?", "Confirm", MessageBoxButtons.YesNo);
            if (Confirm == DialogResult.Yes)
            {
                // attempt to save the part
                string ErrorMessage = Part.SavePart(new Part(Convert.ToInt32(txtPartID.Text), txtName.Text, numBuyPrice.Value, numSellPrice.Value, (int)numQuantity.Value));
                if (ErrorMessage == null) MessageBox.Show("Successfully updated part.", "Success", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);
                else MessageBox.Show(ErrorMessage, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);

                // log changes
                Logging.WriteLog(Logging.LogType.Update, $"part {txtPartID.Text} ({txtName.Text})");
                LoadFormDefaults();
            }
        }
        #endregion
        #region Delete
        private void btnDelete_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            // check that current user has at least "Restricted Write" permission before attempting to delete a part
            string PermissionError = Role.CheckAuthorised(CurrentUser.CurrentLoggedInUser.GetAuthorisationLevel(), 1);
            if (PermissionError != null) { MessageBox.Show(PermissionError, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error); return; }

            // if no part has been selected
            if (_selectedPart == -1) { MessageBox.Show("Select a part to delete."); return; }

            // verify that the user wants to delete the part
            DialogResult Confirm = MessageBox.Show("Are you sure you want to delete this part?", "Warning!", MessageBoxButtons.YesNo);
            if (Confirm == DialogResult.Yes)
            {
                // attempt to delete and output any errors
                string Message = Part.DeletePart(Convert.ToInt32(txtPartID.Text));
                if (Message != null) MessageBox.Show(Message, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                else Logging.WriteLog(Logging.LogType.Delete, $"part {txtPartID.Text} ({txtName.Text})");
                LoadFormDefaults();
            }
        }
        #endregion
        #region Search
        // update the datagridview with appropriate search results when typing in a substring
        private void txtSearch_TextChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            string SearchType = (comboSearchType.SelectedItem?.ToString() == "Exact") ? "Exact" : "Contains";
            dgvParts.DataSource = Part.GetPartsByField(txtSearch.Text, SearchType, _selectedField);
        }

        // if the field to be searched has been modified
        private void comboSearchField_SelectedValueChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            if (comboSearchField.SelectedItem != null)
                _selectedField = ((ComboBoxItem)comboSearchField.SelectedItem).HiddenValue;
        }
        #endregion
        #region Misc
        // prevent further editing by disabling all controls associated with modifying or searching the database
        private void LockDownForm()
        {
            btnAdd.Enabled = false;
            btnSave.Enabled = false;
            btnDelete.Enabled = false;
            btnReset.Enabled = false;

            txtName.Enabled = false;
            txtPartID.Enabled = false;
            txtSearch.Enabled = false;

            numBuyPrice.Enabled = false;
            numSellPrice.Enabled = false;
            numQuantity.Enabled = false;


            comboSearchField.Enabled = false;
            comboSearchType.Enabled = false;
        }


        // reset the form's controls to their default values
        private void btnReset_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            LoadFormDefaults();
        }
        // load the default form control values
        private void LoadFormDefaults()
        {
            AttemptDataDisplay();
            txtPartID.Clear();
            txtName.Clear();
            numBuyPrice.Value = 0;
            numSellPrice.Value = 0;
            numQuantity.Value = 0;
            _selectedPart = -1;
        }

        private void btnHelp_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            frmHelpParts frm = new frmHelpParts();
            frm.Show();

        }
        #endregion


    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Data;
using System.Drawing;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows.Forms;

namespace Petkunas__Lukas___Doherty_Cars
{
    public partial class frmReports : Form
    {
        public frmReports()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
        }

        private void frmReports_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            // for each report, get its adapter, populate a table with that adapter, clear the reports datasrouces, and bind the appropriate dataset and table

            var profitsAdapter = new DataSetAppointmentMonthlyProfitsByMechanicTableAdapters.dtaAppointmentMonthlyProfitsByMechanic();
            DataTable profitsTable = profitsAdapter.GetData();

            rpvAppointmentMonthlyProfitsByMechanic.LocalReport.DataSources.Clear();

            rpvAppointmentMonthlyProfitsByMechanic.LocalReport.DataSources.Add(
                new Microsoft.Reporting.WinForms.ReportDataSource(
                    "DSAppointmentMonthlyProfitsByMechanic",
                    profitsTable
                    )
                );

            var vehicleTypeProfitsAdapter = new DataSetVehicleTypeProfitsTableAdapters.dtaVehicleTypeProfitsTableAdapter();
            DataTable vehicleTypeProfitsTable = vehicleTypeProfitsAdapter.GetData();

            rpvVehicleTypeProfits.LocalReport.DataSources.Clear();

            rpvVehicleTypeProfits.LocalReport.DataSources.Add(
                new Microsoft.Reporting.WinForms.ReportDataSource(
                    "DSVehicleTypeProfits",
                    vehicleTypeProfitsTable
                    )
                );

            var vehicleStockAdapter = new DataSetVehicleStockTableAdapters.dtaVehicleStockTableAdapter();
            DataTable vehicleStockTable = vehicleStockAdapter.GetData();
            rpvVehicleStock.LocalReport.DataSources.Clear();

            rpvVehicleStock.LocalReport.DataSources.Add(
                new Microsoft.Reporting.WinForms.ReportDataSource(
                    "DSVehicleStock",
                    vehicleStockTable
                    )
                );

            var missedAppointmentsAdapter = new DataSetMissedAppointmentTableAdapters.dtaMissedAppointmentsTableAdapter();
            DataTable missedAppointmentsTable = missedAppointmentsAdapter.GetData();
            rpvMissedAppointments.LocalReport.DataSources.Clear();

            rpvMissedAppointments.LocalReport.DataSources.Add(
                new Microsoft.Reporting.WinForms.ReportDataSource(
                    "DSMissedAppointments",
                    missedAppointmentsTable
                    )
                );


            var customerInterestAdapter = new DataSetCustomerInterestTableAdapters.dtaCustomerInterestTableAdapter();
            DataTable customerInterestTable = customerInterestAdapter.GetData();
            rpvCustomerInterest.LocalReport.DataSources.Clear();

            rpvCustomerInterest.LocalReport.DataSources.Add(
                new Microsoft.Reporting.WinForms.ReportDataSource(
                    "DSCustomerInterest",
                    customerInterestTable
                    )
                );


            // populate the list of appointment details
            List<ServiceAppointment> ServiceAppointments = ServiceAppointment.RetrieveAppointments();

            if (ServiceAppointments != null)
            {
                foreach (var sa in ServiceAppointments)
                {
                    Vehicle vec = Vehicle.RetrieveByVehicleID(sa.VehicleID);
                    Staff mec = Staff.RetrieveByStaffID(sa.StaffID);
                    comboAppointmentID.Items.Add(new ComboBoxItem($"{sa.AppointmentID} - {vec.Make} {vec.Model} - {mec.Firstname} {mec.Surname}", sa.AppointmentID.ToString()));
                }
            }
            else MessageBox.Show("Appointments could not be loaded from the databse. Please contact the administrator.", "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);


            // refresh the reports to display the data
            this.rpvAppointmentMonthlyProfitsByMechanic.RefreshReport();
            this.rpvVehicleTypeProfits.RefreshReport();
            this.rpvVehicleStock.RefreshReport();
            this.rpvCustomerInterest.RefreshReport();
            this.rpvMissedAppointments.RefreshReport();
        }

        // when a new appointment has been chosen
        private void comboAppointmentID_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            // get the appointment id from the combobox item, ensuring that an appointment has been selected
            int AppointmentID = comboAppointmentID.SelectedItem == null ? 0 : int.Parse(((ComboBoxItem)(comboAppointmentID.SelectedItem)).HiddenValue);

            // get the appointment, service and item data using that appointment id, and bind to the report
            var InvoiceAdapter = new DataSetInvoicesTableAdapters.dtInvoiceDataTableAdapter();
            DataTable InvoiceTable = InvoiceAdapter.GetData(AppointmentID);
            var ItemsAdapter = new DataSetInvoicesTableAdapters.dtItemsTableAdapter();
            DataTable ItemsTable = ItemsAdapter.GetData(AppointmentID);

            rpvInvoices.LocalReport.DataSources.Clear();


            rpvInvoices.LocalReport.DataSources.Add(
                new Microsoft.Reporting.WinForms.ReportDataSource(
                    "DSInvoiceData",
                    InvoiceTable
                    )
                );

            rpvInvoices.LocalReport.DataSources.Add(
                new Microsoft.Reporting.WinForms.ReportDataSource(
                    "DSItems",
                    ItemsTable
                    )
                );

            this.rpvInvoices.RefreshReport();
        }

        private void btnHelp_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            frmHelpReports frm = new frmHelpReports();
            frm.Show();

        }
    }
}

========================================
FILE: frmRoleData.cs

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Data;
using System.Linq;
using System.Windows.Forms;

namespace Petkunas__Lukas___Doherty_Cars
{
    public partial class frmRoleData : Form
    {
        #region Form properties
        // currently selected role ID
        private int selectedRole = -1;
        // the field to be searched
        private string selectedField = "Name";
        // the fields that can be searched
        private List<ComboBoxItem> fields = new List<ComboBoxItem>
        {
            new ComboBoxItem("Role ID", "RoleID"),
            new ComboBoxItem("Role Name", "Name"),
            new ComboBoxItem("Sector", "Sector"),
            new ComboBoxItem("Authorisation Level", "AuthorisationLevel")
        };
        #endregion
        public frmRoleData()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
        }

        #region Create

        // attempt to add the role to the database
        private void btnAdd_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            // ensure at least "Restricted Write" access before attempting to add
            string permissionError = Role.CheckAuthorised(CurrentUser.CurrentLoggedInUser.GetAuthorisationLevel(), 1);
            if (permissionError != null)
            {
                MessageBox.Show(permissionError, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }

            // carry out basic validation on the role
            List<string> validationErrors = Role.ValidateRole(
                txtName.Text,
                int.Parse(((comboAuthorisationLevel.SelectedItem as ComboBoxItem).HiddenValue)),
                comboSector.Text);

            if (validationErrors.Any())
            {
                MessageBox.Show("- " + string.Join("\n- ", validationErrors), "Validation Errors", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }
            try
            {
                // attempt to add the new role object to the database
                Role newRole = new Role(
                0,
                txtName.Text,
                int.Parse(((comboAuthorisationLevel.SelectedItem as ComboBoxItem).HiddenValue)),
                comboSector.Text);

                string addResult = Role.AddRole(newRole);
                if (addResult == null)
                {
                    MessageBox.Show("Role added successfully.", "Success", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);
                    Logging.WriteLog(Logging.LogType.Create, $"role ({txtName.Text})");
                }
                else
                    MessageBox.Show("Role could not be added:\n" + addResult, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                MessageBox.Show(ex.Message, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }

            LoadFormDefaults();
        }
        #endregion
        #region Retrieve
        private void frmRoleData_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            // add the search fields
            foreach (ComboBoxItem field in fields) comboSearchField.Items.Add(field);
            InitialiseAuthorisation();
            AttemptDataDisplay();

            comboSearchField.SelectedIndex = 0;
            comboSearchType.SelectedIndex = 0;
            comboAuthorisationLevel.SelectedIndex = 0;
            comboSector.SelectedIndex = 0;


        }

        private void AttemptDataDisplay()
        {
            List<Role> result = Role.RetrieveRoles();
            if (result == null)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("There was an error attempting to load roles. Please amend erroneous data in the database before proceeding.", "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                LockDownForm();
                return;
            }
            else
            {
                dgvRoles.DataSource = result;
            }

            dgvRoles.Columns["AuthorisationLevel"].HeaderText = "Authorisation Level";
            dgvRoles.AutoResizeColumns();
        }

        // if a new role has been selected
        private void dgvRoles_SelectionChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            if (dgvRoles.RowCount > 0)
            {

                try
                {
                    // retrieve that role's details and populate the form
                    Role selected = Role.RetrieveByRoleID(Convert.ToInt32(dgvRoles.CurrentRow.Cells[0].Value));
                    if (selected != null)
                    {
                        selectedRole = selected.RoleID;
                        txtRoleID.Text = selected.RoleID.ToString();
                        txtName.Text = selected.Name;
                        comboSector.SelectedItem = comboSector.Items.Cast<string>().Where((ex) => ex.ToString() == selected.Sector).FirstOrDefault();
                        comboAuthorisationLevel.SelectedIndex = selected.AuthorisationLevel;
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    MessageBox.Show("Error when attempting to select role: " + ex, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);

                }
            }
        }
        #endregion
        #region Update
        private void btnSave_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            // ensure at least "Restricted Write" access before attempting to update a role
            string permissionError = Role.CheckAuthorised(CurrentUser.CurrentLoggedInUser.GetAuthorisationLevel(), 1);
            if (permissionError != null)
            {
                MessageBox.Show(permissionError, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }

            // if no role has been selected
            if (selectedRole == -1)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Select a role to edit.");
                return;
            }


            // carry out basic validation on the role details
            List<string> validationErrors = Role.ValidateRole(
                txtName.Text,
                int.Parse((comboAuthorisationLevel.SelectedItem as ComboBoxItem).HiddenValue),
                comboSector.Text);

            if (validationErrors.Any())
            {
                MessageBox.Show("- " + string.Join("\n- ", validationErrors), "Validation Errors", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }

            DialogResult newDialog = MessageBox.Show("Are you sure that you want to overwrite changes?", "Save changes", MessageBoxButtons.YesNo);
            if (newDialog == DialogResult.Yes)
            {
                string errorMessage = null;
                try
                {
                    // attempt to save the new role object
                    errorMessage = Role.SaveRole(new Role(
                Convert.ToInt32(txtRoleID.Text),
                txtName.Text,
                int.Parse(((comboAuthorisationLevel.SelectedItem as ComboBoxItem).HiddenValue)),
                comboSector.Text));
                    if (errorMessage != null) MessageBox.Show(errorMessage);
                    else MessageBox.Show("Successfully updated role", "Success", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);

                    Logging.WriteLog(Logging.LogType.Update, $"role {txtRoleID.Text} ({txtName.Text})");
                    LoadFormDefaults();
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    MessageBox.Show(ex.Message, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error); return;
                }
            }
        }
        #endregion
        #region Delete

        // attempt to delete the role from the database
        private void btnDelete_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            // ensure at least "Restricted Write" access
            string permissionError = Role.CheckAuthorised(CurrentUser.CurrentLoggedInUser.GetAuthorisationLevel(), 1);
            if (permissionError != null)
            {
                MessageBox.Show(permissionError, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }

            // ensure a role has been selected
            if (selectedRole == -1)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Select a role to delete.", "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }

            DialogResult confirm = MessageBox.Show("Are you sure you want to delete this role?", "Confirm Delete", MessageBoxButtons.YesNo);
            if (confirm != DialogResult.Yes) return;


            // display a message if unsuccessful
            string errorMessage = Role.DeleteRole(selectedRole);
            if (errorMessage != null) MessageBox.Show(errorMessage, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
            else Logging.WriteLog(Logging.LogType.Delete, $"role {txtRoleID.Text} ({txtName.Text})");
            LoadFormDefaults();
        }

        #endregion
        #region Search
        // if the field to be searched has changed
        private void comboSearchField_SelectedValueChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            selectedField = ((ComboBoxItem)comboSearchField.SelectedItem).HiddenValue;
        }

        // update the datagridview with the results from the query involving the most up-to-date query substring
        private void txtSearch_TextChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            string searchType = (comboSearchType.SelectedItem?.ToString() == "Exact") ? "Exact" : "Contains";
            dgvRoles.DataSource = Role.GetRolesByField(txtSearch.Text, searchType, selectedField);
        }
        #endregion
        #region Misc
        // prevent further modification or querying by disabling appropriate controls
        private void LockDownForm()
        {
            btnAdd.Enabled = false;
            btnSave.Enabled = false;
            btnDelete.Enabled = false;
            btnReset.Enabled = false;

            txtName.Enabled = false;
            txtRoleID.Enabled = false;
            txtSearch.Enabled = false;

            comboAuthorisationLevel.Enabled = false;
            comboSearchField.Enabled = false;
            comboSearchType.Enabled = false;
            comboSector.Enabled = false;

            dgvRoles.Enabled = false;
        }

        // add authorisation levels to the combobox
        private void InitialiseAuthorisation()
        {
            comboAuthorisationLevel.Items.Clear();
            comboAuthorisationLevel.Items.Add(new ComboBoxItem("0 - Read-only", "0"));
            comboAuthorisationLevel.Items.Add(new ComboBoxItem("1 - Restricted write", "1"));
            comboAuthorisationLevel.Items.Add(new ComboBoxItem("2 - Unrestricted write", "2"));
            comboAuthorisationLevel.SelectedIndex = 0;
        }

        // reset the form to its initial state
        private void LoadFormDefaults()
        {
            AttemptDataDisplay();

            txtRoleID.Clear();
            txtName.Clear();
            comboSector.SelectedIndex = 0;
            comboAuthorisationLevel.SelectedIndex = 0;
            selectedRole = -1;


        }

        private void btnReset_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            LoadFormDefaults();
        }

        private void btnHelp_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            frmHelpRoles frm = new frmHelpRoles();
            frm.Show();

        }
        #endregion



    }
}
