using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Data;
using System.Data.SqlClient;
using System.Drawing;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows.Forms;

namespace Petkunas__Lukas___Doherty_Cars
{
    public partial class frmVehicleData : Form
    {
        #region Form properties
        // the vehicle selected to be edited
        private int _selectedVehicle = -1;
        // the field to be searched
        private string _selectedField = "Make";
        // the fields that can be searched
        private List<ComboBoxItem> _fields = new List<ComboBoxItem>
        {
            new ComboBoxItem("Vehicle ID", "VehicleID"),
            new ComboBoxItem("Vehicle Type ID", "VehicleTypeID"),
            new ComboBoxItem("Customer ID", "CustomerID"),
            new ComboBoxItem("Make", "Make"),
            new ComboBoxItem("Year", "Year"),
            new ComboBoxItem("VIN", "VIN"),
            new ComboBoxItem("License Plate", "LicensePlate"),
            new ComboBoxItem("Condition", "Condition"),
            new ComboBoxItem("Available", "Available"),
            new ComboBoxItem("Inspected", "Inspected"),
            new ComboBoxItem("Buy Price", "BuyPrice"),
            new ComboBoxItem("Sell Price", "SellPrice"),
            new ComboBoxItem("Storage Location", "StorageLocation"),
        };
        #endregion
        public frmVehicleData()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
        }
        #region Create
        // attempt to add the new vehicle to the database
        private void btnAdd_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            // ensure the user has at least "Restricted Write" access before attempting to add
            string permissionError = Role.CheckAuthorised(CurrentUser.CurrentLoggedInUser.GetAuthorisationLevel(), 1);
            if (permissionError != null)
            {
                MessageBox.Show(permissionError, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }

            // validate the vehicle details
            List<string> validationErrors = Vehicle.ValidateVehicleFields(
                0,
                Convert.ToInt32(((ComboBoxItem)comboVehicleTypeID.SelectedItem).HiddenValue),
                comboCustomerID.SelectedIndex == 0
                    ? (int?)null
                    : Convert.ToInt32(((ComboBoxItem)comboCustomerID.SelectedItem).HiddenValue),
                txtMake.Text,
                txtModel.Text,
                chkYearUnknown.Checked ? (int?)null : (int)numYear.Value,
                txtVIN.Text,
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(txtLicensePlate.Text) ? null : txtLicensePlate.Text,
                comboCondition.SelectedItem.ToString(),
                chkAvailable.Checked,
                chkInspected.Checked,
                (double)numBuyPrice.Value,
                (double)numSellPrice.Value,
                comboStorageLocation.SelectedItem.ToString()
            );


            if (validationErrors.Any())
            {
                MessageBox.Show("- " + string.Join("\n- ", validationErrors), "Errors when attempting to save the vehicle", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }

            try
            {
                // attempt to add the new vehicle to the database
                Vehicle newVehicle = new Vehicle(
                0,
                 Convert.ToInt32(((ComboBoxItem)comboVehicleTypeID.SelectedItem).HiddenValue),
                 comboCustomerID.SelectedIndex == 0 ? (int?)null : Convert.ToInt32(((ComboBoxItem)comboCustomerID.SelectedItem).HiddenValue),
                 txtMake.Text,
                 txtModel.Text,
                 chkYearUnknown.Checked ? (int?)null : (int)numYear.Value,
                 txtVIN.Text,
                 string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(txtLicensePlate.Text) ? null : txtLicensePlate.Text,
                 comboCondition.SelectedItem.ToString(),
                 chkAvailable.Checked,
                 chkInspected.Checked,
                 (double)numBuyPrice.Value,
                 (double)numSellPrice.Value,
                 (comboStorageLocation.SelectedItem.ToString() == "None") ? null : comboStorageLocation.SelectedItem.ToString()
                 );
                string addingMessage = Vehicle.AddVehicle(newVehicle);
                if (addingMessage == null)
                {
                    MessageBox.Show("Vehicle has been added successfully.", "Success", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);
                    Logging.WriteLog(Logging.LogType.Create, $"vehicle ({txtMake.Text} {txtModel.Text})");
                }
                else
                {
                    string messageboxText = "Vehicle has not been added:\n" + addingMessage;
                    MessageBox.Show(messageboxText, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Error when attempting to create the vehicle in memory: " + ex.Message, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }
            LoadFormDefaults();  // reset form fields and refresh the data grid view
        }
        #endregion
        #region Retrieve
        private void AttemptDataDisplay()
        {
            List<Vehicle> result = Vehicle.RetrieveVehicles();
            // populate the data grid view with the latest version of the vehicles database stored when the form is loaded
            if (result == null)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("There was an error when attempting to load vehicle data. Please amend erroneous data in the database before proceeding.", "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                LockDownForm();
                return;
            }
            else
            {
                dgvVehicles.DataSource = result;
            }

            // set custom column headers
            dgvVehicles.Columns["VehicleID"].HeaderText = "Vehicle ID";
            dgvVehicles.Columns["VehicleTypeID"].HeaderText = "Vehicle Type";
            dgvVehicles.Columns["CustomerID"].HeaderText = "Customer ID";
            dgvVehicles.Columns["Make"].HeaderText = "Make";
            dgvVehicles.Columns["Model"].HeaderText = "Model";
            dgvVehicles.Columns["Year"].HeaderText = "Year";
            dgvVehicles.Columns["VIN"].HeaderText = "VIN";
            dgvVehicles.Columns["LicensePlate"].HeaderText = "License Plate";
            dgvVehicles.Columns["Condition"].HeaderText = "Condition";
            dgvVehicles.Columns["Available"].HeaderText = "Available";
            dgvVehicles.Columns["Inspected"].HeaderText = "Inspected";
            dgvVehicles.Columns["BuyPrice"].HeaderText = "Buy Price";
            dgvVehicles.Columns["SellPrice"].HeaderText = "Sell Price";
            dgvVehicles.Columns["StorageLocation"].HeaderText = "Storage Location";

            dgvVehicles.AutoResizeColumns();


        }

        private void frmVehicleData_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            PopulateCustomers();
            PopulateVehicleTypeIDs();
            AttemptDataDisplay();
            foreach (ComboBoxItem field in _fields) comboSearchField.Items.Add(field);

            comboSearchType.SelectedIndex = 0;
            comboSearchField.SelectedIndex = 0;
        }

        private void PopulateCustomers()
        {
            List<Customer> Customers = Customer.RetrieveCustomers();
            if (Customers == null)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("No customers could be loaded.", "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                LockDownForm();
                return;
            }
            comboCustomerID.Items.Add(new ComboBoxItem("No customer", null));


            // add each customer to the combobox, with their full name and id
            foreach (Customer Customer in Customers)
            {
                comboCustomerID.Items.Add(new ComboBoxItem($"{Customer.FirstName} {Customer.Surname} - {Customer.CustomerID}", Convert.ToString(Customer.CustomerID)));
            }

            comboCustomerID.SelectedIndex = 0;
        }

        private void PopulateVehicleTypeIDs()
        {
            List<VehicleType> VehicleTypes = VehicleType.RetrieveVehicleTypes();
            if (VehicleTypes == null || VehicleTypes.Count == 0)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("No vehicle types could be loaded.", "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                LockDownForm();
                return;
            }

            // add each vehicletype to the combobox, with its name and id
            foreach (VehicleType VehicleType in VehicleTypes)
            {
                comboVehicleTypeID.Items.Add(new ComboBoxItem($"{VehicleType.Name} - {VehicleType.VehicleTypeID}", Convert.ToString(VehicleType.VehicleTypeID)));
            }

            comboVehicleTypeID.SelectedIndex = 0;
        }

        // when a new vehicle has been chosen in the datagridview
        private void dgvVehicles_SelectionChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            if (dgvVehicles.RowCount > 0)
            {
                try
                {

                    // get the vehicle in question
                    Vehicle edit = Vehicle.RetrieveByVehicleID(Convert.ToInt32(dgvVehicles.CurrentRow.Cells[0].Value));


                    if (edit != null)
                    {
                        txtVehicleID.Text = edit.VehicleID.ToString();

                        // if there is no customer associated with that vehicle, set the index to 0 ("No customer")
                        if (edit.CustomerID == null)
                        {
                            comboCustomerID.SelectedIndex = 0;
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            // find the customer using their id
                            comboCustomerID.SelectedItem = comboCustomerID.Items
                            .Cast<ComboBoxItem>()
                            .Where(g => Convert.ToInt32(g.HiddenValue) == edit.CustomerID)
                            .FirstOrDefault();
                        }

                        // if no year has been provided
                        if (edit.Year == null)
                        {
                            chkYearUnknown.Checked = true;
                            numYear.Enabled = false;
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            numYear.Value = (int)edit.Year;
                            numYear.Enabled = true;
                            chkYearUnknown.Checked = false;
                        }

                        // find the vehicle's vehicle type
                        comboVehicleTypeID.SelectedItem = comboVehicleTypeID.Items
                            .Cast<ComboBoxItem>()
                            .Where(g => Convert.ToInt32(g.HiddenValue) == edit.VehicleTypeID)
                            .FirstOrDefault();

                        // display the vehicle's license plate or - if that's null - an empty string
                        txtLicensePlate.Text = edit.LicensePlate ?? "";


                        txtMake.Text = edit.Make;
                        txtModel.Text = edit.Model;
                        txtVIN.Text = edit.VIN;

                        // find the condition and selected it
                        comboCondition.SelectedItem = comboCondition.Items
                        .Cast<String>()
                        .Where(g => g == edit.Condition)
                        .FirstOrDefault();

                        chkAvailable.Checked = edit.Available;
                        chkInspected.Checked = edit.Inspected;

                        // find the storage location and select it
                        if (edit.StorageLocation == null)
                        {
                            comboStorageLocation.SelectedItem = comboStorageLocation.Items
                        .Cast<String>()
                        .Where(g => g == "None")
                        .FirstOrDefault();
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            comboStorageLocation.SelectedItem = comboStorageLocation.Items
                        .Cast<String>()
                        .Where(g => g == edit.StorageLocation)
                        .FirstOrDefault();
                        }

                        numBuyPrice.Value = (decimal)edit.BuyPrice;
                        numSellPrice.Value = (decimal)edit.SellPrice;

                        _selectedVehicle = edit.VehicleID;
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    MessageBox.Show("Error when attempting to select vehicle:\n" + ex, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                }
            }
        }
        #endregion
        #region Update
        // attempts to save the updated vehicle into the vehicles table
        private void btnSave_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            // ensure the user is permitted to carry the action out first ("Restricted Write" access)
            string permissionError = Role.CheckAuthorised(CurrentUser.CurrentLoggedInUser.GetAuthorisationLevel(), 1);
            if (permissionError != null)
            {
                MessageBox.Show(permissionError, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }

            // if no vehicle has been selected
            if (_selectedVehicle == -1)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Choose a vehicle to edit", "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }

            // validate the input details to ensure that the vehicle would form a valid object
            List<string> ValidationErrors = Vehicle.ValidateVehicleFields(
                Convert.ToInt32(txtVehicleID.Text),
                Convert.ToInt32(((ComboBoxItem)comboVehicleTypeID.SelectedItem).HiddenValue),
                comboCustomerID.SelectedIndex == 0 ? (int?)null : Convert.ToInt32(((ComboBoxItem)comboCustomerID.SelectedItem).HiddenValue),
                txtMake.Text,
                txtModel.Text,
                chkYearUnknown.Checked ? (int?)null : (int)numYear.Value,
                txtVIN.Text,
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(txtLicensePlate.Text) ? null : txtLicensePlate.Text,
                comboCondition.SelectedItem.ToString(),
                chkAvailable.Checked,
                chkInspected.Checked,
                (double)numBuyPrice.Value,
                (double)numSellPrice.Value,
                comboStorageLocation.SelectedItem.ToString()
                );

            if (ValidationErrors.Any())
            {
                MessageBox.Show("- " + string.Join("\n- ", ValidationErrors), "Errors when attempting to save the vehicle", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }


            // verify the user wishes to update the selected vehicle
            DialogResult newDialog = MessageBox.Show("Are you sure that you want to overwrite changes?", "Save changes", MessageBoxButtons.YesNo);
            string errorMessage = null;
            if (newDialog == DialogResult.Yes)
            {
                try
                {
                    // try to save the vehicle using the new vehicle information
                    errorMessage = Vehicle.SaveVehicle(new Vehicle(
                    Convert.ToInt32(txtVehicleID.Text),
                    Convert.ToInt32(((ComboBoxItem)comboVehicleTypeID.SelectedItem).HiddenValue),
                    comboCustomerID.SelectedIndex == 0 ? (int?)null : Convert.ToInt32(((ComboBoxItem)comboCustomerID.SelectedItem).HiddenValue),
                    txtMake.Text,
                    txtModel.Text,
                    chkYearUnknown.Checked ? (int?)null : (int)numYear.Value,
                    txtVIN.Text,
                    string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(txtLicensePlate.Text) ? null : txtLicensePlate.Text,
                    comboCondition.SelectedItem.ToString(),
                    chkAvailable.Checked,
                    chkInspected.Checked,
                    (double)numBuyPrice.Value,
                    (double)numSellPrice.Value,
                    (comboStorageLocation.SelectedItem.ToString() == "None") ? null : comboStorageLocation.SelectedItem.ToString()
                    ));
                    if (errorMessage != null) MessageBox.Show(errorMessage);
                    else MessageBox.Show("Successfully updated vehicle", "Success", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);

                    Logging.WriteLog(Logging.LogType.Update, $"vehicle {txtVehicleID.Text} ({txtMake.Text} {txtModel.Text})");
                    LoadFormDefaults();


                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    MessageBox.Show("There was an error attempting to update the vehicle: " + ex.Message, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                }
            }
        }
        #endregion
        #region Delete

        // attempt to delete the vehicle from the database
        private void btnDelete_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            string permissionError = Role.CheckAuthorised(CurrentUser.CurrentLoggedInUser.GetAuthorisationLevel(), 1);
            if (permissionError != null)
            {
                MessageBox.Show(permissionError, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }

            // if no vehicle has been selected
            if (_selectedVehicle == -1)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Select a vehicle to delete.", "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }

            DialogResult newDialog = MessageBox.Show("Are you sure you wish to delete the selected record?", "Warning!", MessageBoxButtons.YesNo);
            if (newDialog == DialogResult.Yes)
            {
                string errorMessage = Vehicle.DeleteVehicle(Convert.ToInt32(txtVehicleID.Text));
                if (errorMessage != null) MessageBox.Show(errorMessage, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                else Logging.WriteLog(Logging.LogType.Delete, $"vehicle {txtVehicleID.Text} ({txtMake.Text} {txtModel.Text})");
                LoadFormDefaults();
            }
        }
        #endregion
        #region Search
        // when the search field is modified
        private void comboSearchField_SelectedValueChanged(object sender, EventArgs e) => _selectedField = ((ComboBoxItem)comboSearchField.SelectedItem).HiddenValue;



        // update the datagridview as the search subtring is modified
        private void txtSearch_TextChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            string searchType = (comboSearchType.SelectedItem?.ToString() == "Exact") ? "Exact" : "Contains";
            dgvVehicles.DataSource = Vehicle.GetVehiclesByField(txtSearch.Text, searchType, _selectedField);
        }
        #endregion
        #region Misc
        // toggle the numericupdown control based on whether the year is known
        private void chkYearUnknown_CheckedChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            numYear.Enabled = !(chkYearUnknown.Checked);
        }

        private void btnReset_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            LoadFormDefaults();
        }

        private void btnHelp_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            frmHelpVehicles frm = new frmHelpVehicles();
            frm.Show();
        }
        // prevent further editing/viewing by disabling appropriate controls
        private void LockDownForm()
        {
            btnAdd.Enabled = false;
            btnSave.Enabled = false;
            btnDelete.Enabled = false;
            btnReset.Enabled = false;

            chkAvailable.Enabled = false;
            chkInspected.Enabled = false;
            chkYearUnknown.Enabled = false;

            numBuyPrice.Enabled = false;
            numSellPrice.Enabled = false;
            numYear.Visible = false;
            numYear.Enabled = false;

            txtLicensePlate.Enabled = false;
            txtMake.Enabled = false;
            txtModel.Enabled = false;
            txtSearch.Enabled = false;
            txtVehicleID.Enabled = false;
            txtVIN.Enabled = false;

            comboCondition.Enabled = false;
            comboCustomerID.Enabled = false;
            comboSearchField.Enabled = false;
            comboSearchType.Enabled = false;
            comboStorageLocation.Enabled = false;
            comboVehicleTypeID.Enabled = false;

            dgvVehicles.Enabled = false;
        }
        private void LoadFormDefaults()
        {
            // resets form fields and refreshes the data grid view
            AttemptDataDisplay();
            txtVehicleID.Clear();
            comboVehicleTypeID.SelectedIndex = 0;
            txtLicensePlate.Clear();
            txtMake.Clear();
            txtModel.Clear();
            numYear.Value = 1800;
            numYear.Enabled = true;
            chkYearUnknown.Checked = false;
            txtVIN.Clear();
            comboCondition.SelectedIndex = 0;
            chkAvailable.Checked = false;
            chkInspected.Checked = false;
            comboStorageLocation.SelectedIndex = 0;
            comboCustomerID.SelectedIndex = 0;
            numBuyPrice.Value = 0;
            numSellPrice.Value = 0;

            _selectedVehicle = -1;
        }
        #endregion



    }

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Data;
using System.Data.SqlClient;
using System.Drawing;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows.Forms;

namespace Petkunas__Lukas___Doherty_Cars
{
    public partial class frmVehicleTypeData : Form
    {
        #region Form properties
        // the id of the vehicle type selected to be edited
        private int _selectedVehicleType = -1;

        // the name of the field selected to be searched
        private string _selectedField = "Name";

        // the fields that can be searched
        private List<ComboBoxItem> _fields = new List<ComboBoxItem>
        {
            new ComboBoxItem("Vehicle Type ID", "VehicleTypeID"),
            new ComboBoxItem("Name", "Name"),
            new ComboBoxItem("Complexity", "Complexity")
        };
        #endregion

        public frmVehicleTypeData()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
        }

        #region Create
        // attempt to add a new vehicle type to the database
        private void btnAdd_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            // ensure the user is permitted to carry the action out first ("Restricted Write" access)
            string PermissionError = Role.CheckAuthorised(CurrentUser.CurrentLoggedInUser.GetAuthorisationLevel(), 1);
            if (PermissionError != null)
            {
                MessageBox.Show(PermissionError, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }

            // carry out basic validation before attempting to add the new vehicle type
            List<string> ValidationErrors = VehicleType.ValidateVehicleType(txtVehicleTypeName.Text, numComplexity.Value);

            if (ValidationErrors.Any())
            {
                MessageBox.Show("- " + string.Join("\n- ", ValidationErrors), "Errors when attempting to save the vehicle type", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }

            try
            {
                // create a new object with the new information
                VehicleType NewType = new VehicleType(0, txtVehicleTypeName.Text, numComplexity.Value);
                string addingMessage = VehicleType.AddVehicleType(NewType);


                // if no error was output
                if (addingMessage == null)
                {
                    MessageBox.Show("Vehicle type has been added successfully.", "Success", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);
                    Logging.WriteLog(Logging.LogType.Create, $"vehicle type ({txtVehicleTypeName.Text})");
                }
                else
                {
                    MessageBox.Show("Vehicle type has not been added:\n" + addingMessage, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Add unsuccessful:\n- " + ex.Message, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }
            LoadFormDefaults();
        }
        #endregion
        #region Retrieve
        // display data in the datagridview
        private void AttemptDataDisplay()
        {
            List<VehicleType> Result = VehicleType.RetrieveVehicleTypes();
            if (Result == null)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("There was an error attempting to load vehicle type data.", "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                LockDownForm();
                return;
            }
            else
            {
                dgvVehicleTypes.DataSource = Result;
            }

            // set column headers to be human readable
            dgvVehicleTypes.Columns["VehicleTypeID"].HeaderText = "Vehicle Type ID";
            dgvVehicleTypes.Columns["Name"].HeaderText = "Vehicle Type Name";
            dgvVehicleTypes.Columns["Complexity"].HeaderText = "Vehicle Complexity";

            dgvVehicleTypes.AutoResizeColumns();
        }

        // when loading, display data and add search fields
        private void frmVehicleTypeData_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            AttemptDataDisplay();
            foreach (ComboBoxItem field in _fields) comboSearchField.Items.Add(field);

            comboSearchField.SelectedIndex = 0;
            comboSearchType.SelectedIndex = 0;
        }

        // when the selected vehicle type has changed, populate the fields in the form with its values
        private void dgvVehicleTypes_SelectionChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            if (dgvVehicleTypes.RowCount > 0)
            {
                try
                {
                    VehicleType edit = VehicleType.RetrieveByVehicleTypeID(Convert.ToInt32(dgvVehicleTypes.CurrentRow.Cells[0].Value));

                    if (edit != null)
                    {
                        _selectedVehicleType = edit.VehicleTypeID;
                        txtVehicleTypeID.Text = edit.VehicleTypeID.ToString();
                        txtVehicleTypeName.Text = edit.Name;
                        numComplexity.Value = edit.Complexity;
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    MessageBox.Show("Error when attempting to select vehicle type:\n- " + ex, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                }
            }
        }
        #endregion
        #region Update
        // attempt to update the selected vehicle type with new information
        private void btnSave_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            // ensure the user is permitted to carry the action out first ("Restricted Write" access)
            string PermissionError = Role.CheckAuthorised(CurrentUser.CurrentLoggedInUser.GetAuthorisationLevel(), 1);
            if (PermissionError != null)
            {
                MessageBox.Show(PermissionError);
                return;
            }

            // ensure a vehicle has been selected for editing
            if (_selectedVehicleType == -1)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Choose a vehicle type to edit", "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }

            // carry out basic validation before attempting to save
            List<string> ValidationErrors = VehicleType.ValidateVehicleType(txtVehicleTypeName.Text, numComplexity.Value);

            if (ValidationErrors.Any())
            {
                MessageBox.Show("- " + string.Join("\n- ", ValidationErrors), "Errors", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }

            // confirm that the user wants to update the current vehicle type
            DialogResult NewDialog = MessageBox.Show("Are you sure that you want to overwrite changes?", "Save changes", MessageBoxButtons.YesNo);
            if (NewDialog == DialogResult.Yes)
            {
                try
                {
                    // attempt to save, outputting the error message received if unsuccessful
                    string ErrorMessage = VehicleType.SaveVehicleType(
                        new VehicleType(Convert.ToInt32(txtVehicleTypeID.Text), txtVehicleTypeName.Text, numComplexity.Value)
                    );

                    if (ErrorMessage != null) MessageBox.Show(ErrorMessage, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                    else MessageBox.Show("Successfully updated vehicle type", "Success", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);

                    Logging.WriteLog(Logging.LogType.Update, $"vehicle type {txtVehicleTypeID.Text} ({txtVehicleTypeName.Text})");
                    LoadFormDefaults();
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    MessageBox.Show("Save unsuccessful:\n -" + ex.Message, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                }
            }
        }
        #endregion
        #region Delete
        // attempt to delete the vehicle type from the database
        private void btnDelete_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            // ensure the user is permitted to carry the action out first ("Restricted Write" access)
            string PermissionError = Role.CheckAuthorised(CurrentUser.CurrentLoggedInUser.GetAuthorisationLevel(), 1);
            if (PermissionError != null)
            {
                MessageBox.Show(PermissionError, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }


            // ensure a vehicle has been selected to be deleted
            if (_selectedVehicleType == -1)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Select a vehicle type to delete.", "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }

            DialogResult NewDialog = MessageBox.Show("Are you sure you wish to delete the selected record?", "Warning!", MessageBoxButtons.YesNo);
            if (NewDialog == DialogResult.Yes)
            {
                // if there was an error, output it
                string ErrorMessage = VehicleType.DeleteVehicleType(Convert.ToInt32(txtVehicleTypeID.Text));
                if (ErrorMessage != null) MessageBox.Show(ErrorMessage, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                else Logging.WriteLog(Logging.LogType.Delete, $"vehicle type {txtVehicleTypeID.Text} ({txtVehicleTypeName.Text})");
                LoadFormDefaults();
            }
        }
        #endregion
        #region Search

        // update the search field
        private void comboSearchField_SelectedValueChanged(object sender, EventArgs e) => _selectedField = ((ComboBoxItem)comboSearchField.SelectedItem).HiddenValue;


        // update the datagridview using the search criteria
        private void txtSearch_TextChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            string searchType = (comboSearchType.SelectedItem?.ToString() == "Exact") ? "Exact" : "Contains";
            dgvVehicleTypes.DataSource = VehicleType.GetVehicleTypesByField(txtSearch.Text, searchType, _selectedField);
        }
        #endregion
        #region Misc


        // reset the form to its initial state
        private void LoadFormDefaults()
        {
            AttemptDataDisplay();
            txtVehicleTypeName.Clear();
            numComplexity.Value = 0;
            _selectedVehicleType = -1;
        }

        // prevent further editing by disabling all controls related to manipulating or viewing data
        private void LockDownForm()
        {
            btnAdd.Enabled = false;
            btnSave.Enabled = false;
            btnDelete.Enabled = false;
            btnReset.Enabled = false;

            txtSearch.Enabled = false;
            txtVehicleTypeID.Enabled = false;
            txtVehicleTypeName.Enabled = false;

            comboSearchField.Enabled = false;
            comboSearchType.Enabled = false;

            numComplexity.Enabled = false;

            dgvVehicleTypes.Enabled = false;
        }



        private void btnReset_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            LoadFormDefaults();
        }

        private void btnHelp_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            frmHelpVehicleTypes frm = new frmHelpVehicleTypes();
            frm.Show();
        }
        #endregion






    }
}

========================================
FILE: Logging.cs
========================================

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows.Forms;

namespace Petkunas__Lukas___Doherty_Cars
{
    class Logging
    {

        // enum containing the types of logs currently accessible
        public enum LogType
        {
            LoginAttempt,
            Login,
            Access,
            Create,
            Update,
            Delete
        };


        // additionalInfo represents any information that cannot be accessed from within the class
        // this will include usernames, deleted/updated logs, etc.
        // the contents of this additionalInfo must be manually defined depending on the LogType
        public static void WriteLog(LogType LogType, string AdditionalInfo)
        {

            // attempt to create a message based on the logtype provided, and the additionalinfo
            string Message;
            try
            {
                switch (LogType)
                {
                    case (LogType.LoginAttempt):
                        Message = "User " + AdditionalInfo + " had an unsuccessful login attempt [1]";
                        break;
                    case (LogType.Login):
                        Message = "User " + CurrentUser.CurrentLoggedInUser.Username + " logged in [2]";
                        break;
                    case (LogType.Access):
                        Message = "User " + CurrentUser.CurrentLoggedInUser.Username + " accessed the " + AdditionalInfo + " form [3]";
                        break;
                    case (LogType.Create):
                        Message = "User " + CurrentUser.CurrentLoggedInUser.Username + " added a new " + AdditionalInfo + " [4]";
                        break;
                    case (LogType.Update):
                        Message = "User " + CurrentUser.CurrentLoggedInUser.Username + " modified " + AdditionalInfo + " [5]";
                        break;
                    case (LogType.Delete):
                        Message = "User " + CurrentUser.CurrentLoggedInUser.Username + " deleted " + AdditionalInfo + " [6]";
                        break;
                    default:
                        Message = "Unknown log type";
                        break;
                }


            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Message = "Error when attempting to save the log: " + ex.Message;
            }

            // root of the project
            string SolutionRoot = Directory.GetParent(Directory.GetCurrentDirectory()).Parent.FullName;

            // folder containing the logs file
            string MiscPath = Path.Combine(
                SolutionRoot,
                "misc"
            );

            // attempt to create the directory if it doesn't exist
            Directory.CreateDirectory(MiscPath);

            // the path of the file to which logs will be stored
            string FilePath = Path.Combine(MiscPath, "logs.txt");

            // append the new message
            using (var fs = new FileStream(FilePath, FileMode.Append))
            using (var sw = new StreamWriter(fs))
            {
                sw.WriteLine($"[{DateTime.Now.ToString("G")}] - {Message}");
            }
        }

        // processes all logs stored on the system for display in the logs form, filtered by logtype and username
        public static List<ListViewItem> RetrieveLogsAsListViewItems(DateTime Date, LogType? LogType, string Username)
        {
            List<ListViewItem> ListViewItems = new List<ListViewItem>();

            string SolutionRoot = Directory.GetParent(Directory.GetCurrentDirectory()).Parent.FullName;
            string MiscPath = Path.Combine(SolutionRoot, "misc");
            Directory.CreateDirectory(MiscPath);

            string FilePath = Path.Combine(MiscPath, "logs.txt");

            // if there are no logs, output nothing
            if (!File.Exists(FilePath))
                return ListViewItems;


            // all of the logs in the file
            string[] Lines = File.ReadAllLines(FilePath);

            foreach (var Line in Lines)
            {
                try
                {
                    // if filtering by username, and username does not appear in the position where it is expected, ignore
                    if (Username != null)
                    {
                        int firstUserOccurrence = Line.IndexOf(Username);
                        if (firstUserOccurrence == -1 || firstUserOccurrence != Line.IndexOf("User ") + 5) continue;
                    }

                    // if the log isn't formatted properly
                    int firstBracket = Line.IndexOf('[');
                    int secondBracket = Line.IndexOf(']');
                    if (firstBracket < 0 || secondBracket < firstBracket)
                        continue; 

                    // get the date stored in the log
                    string DateStr = Line.Substring(firstBracket + 1, secondBracket - firstBracket - 1);
                    if (!DateTime.TryParse(DateStr, out DateTime LogDate))
                        continue;

                    if (LogDate.Date != Date.Date)
                        continue;

                    // if the date isn't valid or it doesn't match, ignore

                    int lastBracket = Line.LastIndexOf('[');
                    int endBracket = Line.LastIndexOf(']');
                    int CategoryNumber = -1;

                    // if there is a category number, parse it
                    if (lastBracket >= 0 && endBracket > lastBracket)
                    {
                        string numStr = Line.Substring(lastBracket + 1, endBracket - lastBracket - 1);
                        int.TryParse(numStr, out CategoryNumber);
                    }

                    LogType logType;
                    // get the logtype based on the number in the log
                    switch (CategoryNumber)
                    {
                        case 1: logType = Logging.LogType.LoginAttempt; break;
                        case 2: logType = Logging.LogType.Login; break;
                        case 3: logType = Logging.LogType.Access; break;
                        case 4: logType = Logging.LogType.Create; break;
                        case 5: logType = Logging.LogType.Update; break;
                        case 6: logType = Logging.LogType.Delete; break;
                        default: continue;
                    }

                    // if there was a logtype to filter by and it doesn't match
                    if (LogType.HasValue && logType != LogType.Value)
                        continue;

                    

                    // trim the category number off
                    string Message = Line;
                    if (lastBracket > secondBracket)
                        Message = Message.Substring(0, Message.Length - 3).Trim();

                    // add the listviewitem
                    var item = new ListViewItem
                    {
                        Text = Message
                    };

                    ListViewItems.Add(item);
                }
                catch
                {
                    // skip malformed lines
                    continue;
                }
            }

            ListViewItems.Reverse(); // newest first
            return ListViewItems;

        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Data;
using System.Data.SqlClient;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows.Forms;

namespace Petkunas__Lukas___Doherty_Cars
{
    class Part
    {
        #region Private fields
        private int _partID;
        private string _name;
        private decimal _buyPrice;
        private decimal _sellPrice;
        private int _quantity;
        #endregion
        #region Public properties
        public int PartID
        {
            get => _partID;
            set => _partID = value >= 0
                ? value
                : throw new ArgumentException("Part ID must be zero or positive.");
        }

        public string Name
        {
            get => _name;
            set => _name = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value)
                ? value.Trim()
                : throw new ArgumentException("Part name cannot be empty.");
        }

        public decimal BuyPrice
        {
            get => _buyPrice;
            set => _buyPrice = value >= 0
                ? value
                : throw new ArgumentException("Buy price cannot be negative.");
        }

        public decimal SellPrice
        {
            get => _sellPrice;
            set => _sellPrice = value >= 0
                ? value
                : throw new ArgumentException("Sell price cannot be negative.");
        }

        public int Quantity
        {
            get => _quantity;
            set => _quantity = value >= 0
                ? value
                : throw new ArgumentException("Quantity cannot be negative.");
        }
        #endregion
        #region Constructors
        public Part() { }

        public Part(int PartID, string Name, decimal BuyPrice, decimal SellPrice, int Quantity)
        {
            this.PartID = PartID;
            this.Name = Name;
            this.BuyPrice = BuyPrice;
            this.SellPrice = SellPrice;
            this.Quantity = Quantity;
        }
        #endregion

        #region Validation

        // basic validation to ensure that the details provided would form a valid part
        public static List<string> ValidatePart(
            int PartID,
            string Name,
            decimal BuyPrice,
            decimal SellPrice,
            int Quantity)
        {
            List<string> Errors = new List<string>();

            if (PartID < 0)
                Errors.Add("Part ID must be zero or positive.");

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Name))
                Errors.Add("Part name cannot be empty.");

            if (Name.Length > 50)
                Errors.Add("Part name cannot be longer than 50 characters.");

            if (BuyPrice < 0)
                Errors.Add("Buy price cannot be negative.");

            if (SellPrice < 0)
                Errors.Add("Sell price cannot be negative.");

            if (Quantity < 0)
                Errors.Add("Quantity cannot be negative.");

            return Errors;
        }
        #endregion
        #region Create
        // add a new part into the parts table
        public static string AddPart(Part NewPart)
        {
            try
            {
                string Query = @"
                    INSERT INTO Parts (Name, BuyPrice, SellPrice, Quantity)
                    VALUES (@Name, @BuyPrice, @SellPrice, @Quantity)";

                using (var Connection = DBConnect.ConnectionToDB())
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(Query, Connection))
                {
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Name", NewPart.Name);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@BuyPrice", NewPart.BuyPrice);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@SellPrice", NewPart.SellPrice);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Quantity", NewPart.Quantity);

                    Connection.Open();
                    cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
                }

                return null;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                return "Error adding part:\n- " + ex.Message;
            }
        }
        #endregion
        #region Update
        // update an existing record with new details
        public static string SavePart(Part ExistingPart)
        {
            try
            {
                string Query = @"
            UPDATE Parts
            SET Name = @Name,
                BuyPrice = @BuyPrice,
                SellPrice = @SellPrice,
                Quantity = @Quantity
            WHERE PartID = @PartID";

                using (var Connection = DBConnect.ConnectionToDB())
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(Query, Connection))
                {
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@PartID", ExistingPart.PartID);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Name", ExistingPart.Name);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@BuyPrice", ExistingPart.BuyPrice);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@SellPrice", ExistingPart.SellPrice);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Quantity", ExistingPart.Quantity);

                    Connection.Open();
                    cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
                }

                return null; // success
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                return "Error updating part record: " + ex.Message;
            }
        }
        #endregion
        #region Retrieve
        // gets all parts from the parts table
        public static List<Part> RetrieveParts()
        {
            List<Part> Results = new List<Part>();

            try
            {
                DataTable Table = new DataTable();

                using (var Connection = DBConnect.ConnectionToDB())
                using (var Adapter = new SqlDataAdapter(
                    "SELECT * FROM Parts WHERE DateDeleted IS NULL",
                    Connection))
                {
                    Adapter.Fill(Table);
                }

                foreach (DataRow row in Table.Rows)
                    Results.Add(FromDataRow(row));

                return Results;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Error retrieving parts:\n- " + ex.Message, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return null;
            }
        }

        // gets a part given its id
        public static Part RetrieveByPartID(int id)
        {
            try
            {
               
                DataTable Table = new DataTable();

                using (var Connection = DBConnect.ConnectionToDB())
                using (var Adapter = new SqlDataAdapter(
                    "SELECT * FROM Parts WHERE PartID = @PartID AND DateDeleted IS NULL",
                    Connection))
                {
                    Adapter.SelectCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@PartID", id);
                    Adapter.Fill(Table);
                }

                // if there is a part with that id
                return Table.Rows.Count > 0 ? FromDataRow(Table.Rows[0]) : null;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Error retrieving part:\n- " + ex.Message, "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return null;
            }
        }
        #endregion     
        #region Delete
        public static string DeletePart(int id)
        {
            try
            {
                using (var connection = DBConnect.ConnectionToDB())
                using (var cmd = connection.CreateCommand())
                {
                    // raises an error if there is any appointment that uses that part
                    cmd.CommandText = @"
                        IF EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1
                        FROM ServiceAppointmentsServicesParts 
                        WHERE PartID = @PartID
                        AND DateDeleted IS NULL
                        )
                        BEGIN
                            RAISERROR('Part is used in service appointments and cannot be deleted.', 16, 1);
                            RETURN;
                        END

                        
                        UPDATE Parts
                        SET DateDeleted = GETDATE()
                        WHERE PartID = @PartID
                        AND DateDeleted IS NULL;";

                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@PartID", id);
                    connection.Open();
                    cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
                    return null;
                }
            }
            catch(Exception ex)
            {
                return "Part delete unsuccessful:\n- " + ex.Message;
            }
        }
        #endregion
        #region Mapping
        // parses a part given its row representation in the table
        public static Part FromDataRow(DataRow row)
        {
            return new Part(
                (int)row["PartID"],
                row["Name"].ToString(),
                (decimal)row["BuyPrice"],
                (decimal)row["SellPrice"],
                (int)row["Quantity"]
            );
        }
        #endregion
        #region Search
        // returns a list of parts that match the given criteria
        public static List<Part> GetPartsByField(string SearchTerm, string SearchType, string Field)
        {
            List<Part> results = new List<Part>();

            try
            {
                DataTable table = new DataTable();

                using (var connection = DBConnect.ConnectionToDB())
                using (var adapter = new SqlDataAdapter(
                    // modify the query based on the search type
                    $"SELECT * FROM Parts WHERE {Field} {(SearchType == "Exact" ? "=" : "LIKE")} @Value AND DateDeleted IS NULL",
                    connection))
                {
                    if (SearchType == "Exact")
                        adapter.SelectCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Value", SearchTerm);
                    else
                        adapter.SelectCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Value", "%" + SearchTerm + "%");

                    adapter.Fill(table);
                }

                foreach (DataRow row in table.Rows)
                    results.Add(FromDataRow(row));

                return results;
            }
            catch
            {
                return new List<Part>();
            }
        }
        #endregion
    }
}

                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@AuthorisationLevel", NewRole.AuthorisationLevel);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Sector", NewRole.Sector);

                    Connection.Open();
                    cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();

                return null;

                            WHERE RoleID = @RoleID

        // see if the authorisation level provided is greater than or equal to the one required, either outputting nothing or an appropriate error message
        public static string CheckAuthorised(int AuthorisationGiven, int AuthorisationRequired)
        {

            if (AuthorisationGiven >= AuthorisationRequired) return null;
            Dictionary<int, string> LevelToPermissions = new Dictionary<int, string>
           {
               {0, "Read-only" },
               {1, "Restricted write"},
               {2, "Unrestricted write"}
           };

            return "This action requires \"" + LevelToPermissions[AuthorisationRequired] + "\" permission, but you have \"" + LevelToPermissions[AuthorisationGiven] + "\"";
        }

========================================
FILE: Service.cs
========================================

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Data;
using System.Data.SqlClient;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows.Forms;

namespace Petkunas__Lukas___Doherty_Cars
{
    class Service
    {
        #region Private fields
        private int _serviceID;
        private string _name;
        private string _description;
        private int _durationHours;
        private decimal _price;
        #endregion

        #region Public properties
        public int ServiceID
        {
            get => _serviceID;
            set => _serviceID = value >= 0
                ? value
                : throw new ArgumentException("Service ID must be zero or positive.");
        }

        public string Name
        {
            get => _name;
            set => _name = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value)
                ? value.Trim()
                : throw new ArgumentException("Service name cannot be empty.");
        }

        public string Description
        {
            get => _description;
            set
            {
                if (value?.Length > 500)
                    throw new ArgumentException("Description cannot exceed 500 characters.");
                _description = value?.Trim() ?? "";
            }
        }

        public int DurationHours
        {
            get => _durationHours;
            set => _durationHours = (value > 0 && value <= 10)
                ? value
                : throw new ArgumentException("Duration must be between 1 and 10 hours.");
        }

        public decimal Price
        {
            get => _price;
            set => _price = value >= 0
                ? value
                : throw new ArgumentException("Price cannot be negative.");
        }
        #endregion

        #region Constructors
        public Service() { }

        public Service(int ServiceID, string Name, string Description, int DurationHours, decimal Price)
        {
            this.ServiceID = ServiceID;
            this.Name = Name;
            this.Description = Description;
            this.DurationHours = DurationHours;
            this.Price = Price;
        }
        #endregion

        #region Validation
        // basic checks to ensure that the details provided would form a valid service object
        public static List<string> ValidateService(int ServiceID, string Name, string Description, int DurationHours, decimal Price)
        {
            List<string> Errors = new List<string>();

            if (ServiceID < 0)
                Errors.Add("Service ID must be greater than or equal to 0");

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Name))
                Errors.Add("Service name cannot be empty.");

            if(Name.Length > 50)
                Errors.Add("Service name cannot exceed 50 characters");
           
            if (Description?.Length > 500)
                Errors.Add("Description cannot exceed 500 characters.");

            if (DurationHours <= 0 || DurationHours > 10)
                Errors.Add("Duration must be between 1 and 10 hours.");

            if (Price < 0)
                Errors.Add("Price cannot be negative.");

            return Errors;
        }
        #endregion

        #region Create
        // add a new service into the Services table
        public static string AddService(Service NewService)
        {
            try
            {
                string Query = @"
                    INSERT INTO Services (Name, Description, DurationHours, Price)
                    VALUES (@Name, @Description, @DurationHours, @Price)";

                using (var Connection = DBConnect.ConnectionToDB())
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(Query, Connection))
                {
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Name", NewService.Name);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Description", NewService.Description);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@DurationHours", NewService.DurationHours);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Price", NewService.Price);

                    Connection.Open();
                    cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
                }

                return null; // success
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                return "Error adding service:\n" + ex.Message;
            }
        }
        #endregion

        #region Retrieve
        // get all services from the Services table
        public static List<Service> RetrieveServices()
        {
            List<Service> Results = new List<Service>();
            try
            {
                DataTable Table = new DataTable();
                using (var Connection = DBConnect.ConnectionToDB())
                using (var Adapter = new SqlDataAdapter(
                    "SELECT * FROM Services WHERE DateDeleted IS NULL",
                    Connection))
                {
                    Adapter.Fill(Table);
                }

                foreach (DataRow row in Table.Rows)
                    Results.Add(FromDataRow(row));

                return Results;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("There was an error retrieving services:\n- " + ex.Message);
                return null;
            }
        }

        // get a service given its id
        public static Service RetrieveByServiceID(int id)
        {
            try
            {
                DataTable Table = new DataTable();
                using (var Connection = DBConnect.ConnectionToDB())
                using (var Adapter = new SqlDataAdapter(
                    "SELECT * FROM Services WHERE ServiceID = @ServiceID AND DateDeleted IS NULL",
                    Connection))
                {
                    Adapter.SelectCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ServiceID", id);
                    Adapter.Fill(Table);
                }

                // if any services had that id
                return Table.Rows.Count > 0 ? FromDataRow(Table.Rows[0]) : null;
            }
            catch
            {
                return null;
            }
        }
        #endregion

        #region Delete

        // delete a service given its id
        // services will not be deleted if they are currently being used in an appointment
        public static string DeleteService(int id)
        {
            try
            {
                using (var Connection = DBConnect.ConnectionToDB())
                using (var cmd = Connection.CreateCommand())
                {
                    cmd.CommandText = @"
                    IF EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1
                        FROM ServiceAppointmentsServices -- assuming junction table
                        WHERE ServiceID = @ServiceID
                     AND DateDeleted IS NULL
                    )
                    BEGIN
                        THROW 50000, 'Service is currently used in service appointments and cannot be deleted.', 1;
                    END

                    UPDATE Services
                    SET DateDeleted = GETDATE()
                    WHERE ServiceID = @ServiceID
                    AND DateDeleted IS NULL;"; ;

                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ServiceID", id);
                    Connection.Open();
                    cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
                    return null;
                }
            }
            catch(Exception ex)
            {
                return "Service delete unsuccessful:\n" + ex.Message;
            }
        }
        #endregion

        #region Mapping
        // parses a service given its row representation in the table
        public static Service FromDataRow(DataRow row)
        {
            return new Service(
                (int)row["ServiceID"],
                row["Name"].ToString(),
                row["Description"].ToString(),
                (int)row["DurationHours"],
                (decimal)row["Price"]
            );
        }
        #endregion

        // update an existing service with new details
        public static string SaveService(Service ExistingService)
        {
            try
            {
                string Query = @"
            UPDATE Services
            SET Name = @Name,
                Description = @Description,
                DurationHours = @DurationHours,
                Price = @Price
            WHERE ServiceID = @ServiceID";

                using (var Connection = DBConnect.ConnectionToDB())
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(Query, Connection))
                {
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ServiceID", ExistingService.ServiceID);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Name", ExistingService.Name);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Description", ExistingService.Description);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@DurationHours", ExistingService.DurationHours);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Price", ExistingService.Price);

                    Connection.Open();
                    cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
                }

                return null; // success
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                return "Error updating service record:\n" + ex.Message;
            }
        }


        #region Search
        public static List<Service> GetServicesByField(string SearchTerm, string SearchType, string Field)
        {
            List<Service> Results = new List<Service>();
            try
            {
                DataTable Table = new DataTable();

                using (var Connection = DBConnect.ConnectionToDB())
                using (var Adapter = new SqlDataAdapter(
                    $"SELECT * FROM Services WHERE {Field} {(SearchType == "Exact" ? "=" : "LIKE")} @Value AND DateDeleted IS NULL",
                    Connection)) // modify the search query depending on the search type
                {
                    if (SearchType == "Exact")
                        Adapter.SelectCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Value", SearchTerm);
                    else
                        Adapter.SelectCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Value", "%" + SearchTerm + "%");

                    Adapter.Fill(Table);
                }

                foreach (DataRow row in Table.Rows)
                    Results.Add(FromDataRow(row));

                return Results;
            }
            catch
            {           
                return new List<Service>();
            }
        }
        #endregion
    }
}
